title: Author popularity ranking
statementMd:
Rank authors by total loans of their books with `DENSE_RANK` (1 = most loans). Show rank, author and loans, only the top 5 ranks, ordered by rank then author.

Expected columns: `rk`, `name`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Aggregate loans per author, then rank.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH t AS (SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id GROUP BY a.id, a.name), r AS (SELECT name, loans, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loans DESC) AS rk FROM t) SELECT rk, name, loans FROM r WHERE rk <= 5 ORDER BY rk, name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
